title: tanacetum caucasicum
intro: Tanacetum caucasicum, commonly known as Caucasian chamomile, is a flowering plant native to the Caucasus region. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, soothing anxiety, and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Tanacetum caucasicum are attributed to its sedative and spasmolytic properties, which can help to calm the nervous system and alleviate muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, terpenoids, and essential oils, such as alpha-pinene and beta-pinene, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
